Definition
[Interior tangent cone] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0439 1. apph:H.11\group Locally convex subsets For $S\subset \M $ and $p\in S$, define $\T _pS$ as the set of vectors $V$ for which $\exp _p(sV)\in \operatorname {int}(S)$ for all sufficiently small $s>0$.
